title: Őrizem a szemed
author: Endre Ady
sourceTitle: A halottak élén · 1918 · p. 193 / PDF p. 199
context: The 1918 scan prints this complete poem in four quatrains, repeating the first as the third. The National Library's online transcription of its separately headed 1916 Nyugat appearance agrees in wording, punctuation and stanza breaks; that online transcription is not a facsimile. Lajos Hatvany and the poet's brother Lajos Ady helped prepare the 1918 volume; specific edits to this poem are not attributed to either. The Petőfi Literary Museum names the individual poem among Ady's periodical works. Hungary is an associated place, not a claim about where it was written.
rights: The 1918 printing of this poem is public domain in the United States; Ady died in 1919. Hatvany died in 1961 and Lajos Ady in 1940. Copyright, edition-related and moral rights vary by jurisdiction; check local law. The scan is linked, not republished; no translation, score or recording is included.
text:
Már vénülő kezemmel
Fogom meg a kezedet,
Már vénülő szememmel
Őrizem a szemedet.

Világok pusztulásán
Ősi vad, kit rettenet
Űz, érkeztem meg hozzád
S várok riadtan veled.

Már vénülő kezemmel
Fogom meg a kezedet,
Már vénülő szememmel
Őrizem a szemedet.

Nem tudom, miért, meddig
Maradok meg még neked,
De a kezedet fogom
S őrizem a szemedet.
